title: 隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿
summary: 本課以以掌子面擠出、玻纖筋黏結與開挖保留長度控制面補強為主線，從掌子面擠出與地層核心與補強密度與非均勻分擔建立系統邊界，再把開挖進尺與保留長度、施工時間與黏結成熟連到面補強與周邊支護協調。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on control face reinforcement through extrusion, fibre-bar bond and retained length. It begins with Face extrusion and ground core and Reinforcement density and unequal sharing, links Advance and retained reinforcement and Construction time and bond maturity, and ends with Face reinforcement and peripheral support. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「掌子面擠出與地層核心」與「補強密度與非均勻分擔」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Face extrusion and ground core" and "Reinforcement density and unequal sharing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Face extrusion and ground core: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「掌子面擠出與地層核心」如何影響隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Face extrusion and ground core” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 面前地層向開挖空間擠出會削弱拱效應，補強筋透過黏結抑制核心變形。量到的面位移包含開挖卸載與地層時效，不能直接當作每根筋伸長；應先定義量測參考長度及未擾動基準，再比較不同進尺的擠出增量。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時；若出現基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「掌子面擠出與地層核心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground extruding toward the opening weakens arching, while bonded bars restrain the core. Face movement includes unloading and time effects rather than each bar's extension. Define reference length and an undisturbed datum before comparing extrusion increments at different excavation advances. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. If a datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Face extrusion and ground core” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「面位移除以長度就是每支玻纖筋的真實應變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Face movement divided by length equals the actual strain of every bar" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「掌子面擠出與地層核心」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Face extrusion and ground core”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿」的「掌子面擠出與地層核心：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「都會地下工區協調」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Face extrusion and ground core: mechanism and system paths” in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban underground coordination” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.explanationEn: Ground extruding toward the opening weakens arching, while bonded bars restrain the core. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Face extrusion and ground core: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「掌子面擠出與地層核心」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Face extrusion and ground core” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Face extrusion and ground core: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「掌子面擠出與地層核心」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Face extrusion and ground core” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「掌子面擠出與地層核心」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Face extrusion and ground core"?
options: 將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時。

optionsEn: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Small central face movement proves the entire core is free of shear
quiz.explanation: 將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Face extrusion and ground core: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「掌子面擠出與地層核心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Face extrusion and ground core” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時；若出現基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「面位移除以長度就是每支玻纖筋的真實應變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Face movement divided by length equals the actual strain of every bar" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 補強密度與非均勻分擔：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reinforcement density and unequal sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「補強密度與非均勻分擔」如何影響隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reinforcement density and unequal sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每支筋對應的面積可描述幾何密度，卻不是固定承載分區。面中心、周邊及薄弱夾層的變形不同，黏結尚未動員的筋可能幾乎不受力；密度比較應同時看長度與岩土變形，避免只用根數評估面穩定。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布；若出現均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「補強密度與非均勻分擔」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Area per bar describes geometric density rather than a fixed load tributary. Centre, edge and weak-layer movements differ, and bars with unmobilized bond may carry little load. Compare density together with length and ground deformation instead of judging face stability from count alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers. If uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reinforcement density and unequal sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「面積除以筋數就能決定每支筋一定承受的荷載」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Area divided by bar count determines the exact force in each bar" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「補強密度與非均勻分擔」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reinforcement density and unequal sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 每支筋對應的面積可描述幾何密度，卻不是固定承載分區。面中心、周邊及薄弱夾層的變形不同，黏結尚未動員的筋可能幾乎不受力；密度比較應同時看長度與岩土變形，避免只用根數評估面穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Area per bar describes geometric density rather than a fixed load tributary. Centre, edge and weak-layer movements differ, and bars with unmobilized bond may carry little load.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：面積除以筋數就能決定每支筋一定承受的荷載 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Area divided by bar count determines the exact force in each bar Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「補強密度與非均勻分擔」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

每支筋對應的面積可描述幾何密度，卻不是固定承載分區。

A fibre bar yields extensively like steel before it fails
Area per bar describes geometric density rather than a fixed load tributary.

steps.title: 補強密度與非均勻分擔：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reinforcement density and unequal sharing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「補強密度與非均勻分擔」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reinforcement density and unequal sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「補強密度與非均勻分擔」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Installing long bars once permits unlimited continuous excavation
Hard grout at the collar proves final strength along the entire anchorage

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 補強密度與非均勻分擔：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reinforcement density and unequal sharing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「補強密度與非均勻分擔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reinforcement density and unequal sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
